_label: Static reference candidates for pharmacist review when a drug is out of stock - not an AI-generated substitution. PharmaFlow may only propose a drug from this list, and never without pharmacist approval.

Sodium Bicarbonate.name: Potassium Citrate
Sodium Bicarbonate.note: Alternative alkalinizing agent used in CKD metabolic acidosis management. Renal dosing must be confirmed by the prescriber before use.

Sumatriptan.name: Rizatriptan
Sumatriptan.note: Same drug class (triptan) for acute migraine. Carries the same SSRI interaction consideration as sumatriptan; pharmacist should re-screen before dispensing.
